purchases.title: Philip Charter: The Totally Human Writer
purchases.summary:
In this conversation, Bitcoin For The Arts founder Dion Wilson sits down with Philip Charter, the British author, editor, and ghostwriter behind Totally Human Writer, and the co-editor of 21 Futures, the world's first Bitcoin fiction anthology.
Philip lives in Gran Canaria. He is the co-editor of 21 Futures: Tales from the Timechain, a collection of twenty-one stories from twenty-one authors including Knut Svanholm and Ioni Appelberg, released by Konsensus Network in 2023 and presented at Bitcoin Atlantis in 2024. purchases.title: Bitbrand: Bitcoin Saved My Life
purchases.summary:
Bitbrand makes hand-branded Bitcoin goods the old way: steel, fire, and leather. No ink, no printer, and no two pieces alike. He invented the Bitcoin branding iron, calls himself the branding iron broker, and built the company from the back of a van.
In this episode of Share Your Bitcoin Journey, Bitcoin For The Arts founder Dion Wilson meets Bitbrand in Jersey City, after they first met at the Midwest Bitcoin Summit in Columbus. purchases.title: Benjamin Ella: Seventeen Seasons at the Royal Ballet, Then Bitcoin
purchases.summary:
Benjamin Ella danced seventeen seasons as a soloist of the Royal Ballet. He arrived from Melbourne at fifteen on a full scholarship, graduated with a stress fracture in the navicular, and was kept by Dame Monica Mason while two titanium pins and three hard years decided whether he would dance at all.

purchases.title: Fzero: The Artist Creates First
purchases.summary: Fzero is a designer, illustrator, node runner, and co-founder of Ninefold, the studio he runs with Ivy Lumi. Their line is "stories that make you build." He started by copying manga as a kid. He studied economics, finance, and marketing, then opened stores and ran the floor for big fashion brands. The work looked like a career. It did not feel like one. On December 25, still under 30 and home with his family, he had a stroke. He already knew Bitcoin. He had been stacking sats for years. The scare settled the question. purchases.title: Thomas Forsyth: The General Handychap Path to Sound Money
purchases.summary:
Thomas Forsyth is a London designer, maker, and engineer. His work spans the Saatchi Gallery, Glastonbury Festival, the Wall Street Journal's Apple Car, and a Star Wars K-2SO build for Silicon Valley Comic Con. He calls himself a general handychap.
